label: Image Method
description: Calls a documented method on a ThunderPHP Core\Image object.

properties.name: result_variable
properties.label: Result variable
properties.help: Optional PHP variable name. Omit the $ sign. Leave blank to use the automatic node-specific name.

methods.name: resize
methods.label: Resize
methods.description: Resizes an image proportionally so its longest side fits within the requested maximum size.
methods.help:
Resizes an image proportionally so its longest side fits within the requested maximum size.

### Example

```php
$image = new \Core\Image();
$image->resize(ROOTPATH . 'public/uploads/photo.jpg', 1200);
```

### Notes

- The original aspect ratio is preserved; the image is not stretched.
- When `dest` is omitted, the original file is overwritten.
- Use `crop()` or `fit_contain()` when exact outer dimensions are required.

methods.name: crop
methods.label: Crop
methods.description: Creates an image with exact dimensions by cropping the source to the requested aspect ratio.
methods.help:
Creates an image with exact dimensions by cropping the source to the requested aspect ratio.

### Example

```php
$image = new \Core\Image();
$image->crop(ROOTPATH . 'public/uploads/photo.jpg', 300, 300);
```

### Notes

- Supported alignment values include `center`, `top`, `bottom`, `left`, and `right`.
- Cropping is appropriate for uniform cards, avatars, and product grids where every output must have identical dimensions.

methods.name: fit_contain
methods.label: Fit Contain
methods.description: Fits the complete image inside a fixed box without cropping and fills any unused area with a background color.
methods.help:
Fits the complete image inside a fixed box without cropping and fills any unused area with a background color.

### Example

```php
$image = new \Core\Image();

$image->fit_contain(
    ROOTPATH . 'public/uploads/logo.png',
    400,
    300,
    ROOTPATH . 'public/uploads/logo_preview.png'
);
```

### Notes

- The whole source remains visible.
- Use RGB backgrounds such as `[255,255,255]`, or an alpha value for transparent-capable PNG/WEBP output.

methods.name: save_as
methods.label: Save As
methods.description: Reads an existing image and writes it to a destination whose extension determines the output format.
methods.help:
Reads an existing image and writes it to a destination whose extension determines the output format.

### Example

```php
$image = new \Core\Image();

$image->save_as(
    ROOTPATH . 'public/uploads/photo.jpg',
    ROOTPATH . 'public/uploads/photo.webp'
);
```

### Notes

- The destination extension selects JPEG, PNG, GIF, or WEBP output.
- This method is useful for format conversion while preserving the original source file.

methods.name: convert_to_webp
methods.label: Convert to WEBP
methods.description: Convenience method that saves an existing image as WEBP.
methods.help:
Convenience method that saves an existing image as WEBP.

### Example

```php
$image = new \Core\Image();
$image->convert_to_webp(ROOTPATH . 'public/uploads/photo.jpg');
```

### Notes

- When `dest` is omitted, a path with the same base filename and a `.webp` extension is created.
- Configure compression with `set_webp_quality()` before conversion.

methods.name: get_thumbnail
methods.label: Get Thumbnail
methods.description: Creates or reuses a thumbnail using the class naming rules and the selected crop, resize, or contain mode.
methods.help:
Creates or reuses a thumbnail using the class naming rules and the selected crop, resize, or contain mode.

### Example

```php
$image = new \Core\Image();
$thumb = $image->get_thumbnail(
    ROOTPATH . 'public/uploads/photo.jpg',
    300,
    300
);
```

### Notes

- If the thumbnail already exists and `replace` is false, the existing path is returned.
- Supported modes are `crop`, `resize`, and `contain`.
- `output_ext` can force a format such as `webp`.

methods.name: make_thumbnail
methods.label: Make Thumbnail
methods.description: Creates a thumbnail at an explicit destination path, giving the caller full control over the filename.
methods.help:
Creates a thumbnail at an explicit destination path, giving the caller full control over the filename.

### Example

```php
$image = new \Core\Image();

$image->make_thumbnail(
    ROOTPATH . 'public/uploads/photo.jpg',
    ROOTPATH . 'public/uploads/thumbs/photo_small.jpg',
    300,
    300,
    'crop'
);
```

### Notes

- Use this when you need an exact destination path rather than automatic thumbnail naming.
- Missing destination directories are created where possible.

methods.name: make_thumbnail_as
methods.label: Make Thumbnail As
methods.description: Creates a thumbnail at an explicit destination and allows its format to differ from the source image.
methods.help:
Creates a thumbnail at an explicit destination and allows its format to differ from the source image.

### Example

```php
$image = new \Core\Image();

$image->make_thumbnail_as(
    ROOTPATH . 'public/uploads/photo.jpg',
    ROOTPATH . 'public/uploads/thumbs/photo_small.webp',
    300,
    300,
    'crop'
);
```

### Notes

- The destination extension controls the output format.
- This is useful for generating WEBP thumbnails from JPEG or PNG originals.

methods.name: smart_thumbnail
methods.label: Smart Thumbnail
methods.description: Generates several thumbnail specifications in one call and returns structured information for every generated asset.
methods.help:
Generates several thumbnail specifications in one call and returns structured information for every generated asset.

### Example

```php
$image = new \Core\Image();

$versions = $image->smart_thumbnail($original, [
    ['width' => 150, 'height' => 150, 'mode' => 'crop', 'ext' => 'webp'],
    ['width' => 400, 'height' => 250, 'mode' => 'crop', 'ext' => 'webp'],
    ['width' => 1200, 'height' => 630, 'mode' => 'crop', 'ext' => 'webp'],
]);
```

### Notes

- Each specification may define `width`, `height`, `mode`, `ext`, `bg_color`, `position`, `replace`, and `dest`.
- The result contains top-level `success`, `items`, and `error`; every item includes path and image metadata.

methods.name: from_upload
methods.label: Store Uploaded Image
methods.description: Stores an uploaded image from a PHP file array and returns a structured success or error result.

methods.name: from_string
methods.label: Create from Binary String
methods.description: Writes raw binary image data to a file and verifies that the resulting file is a valid image.

methods.name: process
methods.label: Generic Process
methods.description: Runs resize, crop, or contain mode through one generic method and returns a structured result array.
methods.help:
Runs resize, crop, or contain mode through one generic method and returns a structured result array.

### Example

```php
$image = new \Core\Image();

$result = $image->process(
    ROOTPATH . 'public/uploads/photo.jpg',
    'crop',
    [
        'width' => 300,
        'height' => 300,
        'position' => 'top',
        'dest' => ROOTPATH . 'public/uploads/photo_square.jpg',
    ]
);
```

### Notes

- Supported modes are `resize`, `crop`, and `contain`.
- The returned array includes `success`, `path`, `mime`, `width`, `height`, `size`, and `error`.

methods.name: get_size
methods.label: Get Size
methods.description: Reads image metadata and returns width, height, and MIME type, or false when the file cannot be read.

methods.name: output
methods.label: Output to Browser
methods.description: Sends an image file directly to the browser with the appropriate headers.
methods.help:
Sends an image file directly to the browser with the appropriate headers.

### Example

```php
$image = new \Core\Image();
$image->output(ROOTPATH . 'public/uploads/thumbs/photo.webp');
```

### Notes

- Call this before any HTML or other output because sent headers cause it to fail.
- Supply `download_name` to force a download; `exit_after` controls whether execution ends after output.

methods.name: delete_thumbnails
methods.label: Delete Thumbnails
methods.description: Removes generated thumbnails that match the class naming pattern for a source image.
methods.help:
Removes generated thumbnails that match the class naming pattern for a source image.

### Example

```php
$image = new \Core\Image();
$image->delete_thumbnails(ROOTPATH . 'public/uploads/photo.jpg');
```

### Notes

- Useful when an original image is replaced and stale generated versions must be removed.

methods.name: set_jpeg_quality
methods.label: Set JPEG Quality
methods.description: Sets JPEG output quality from 0 to 100 and returns the Image object for chaining.
methods.help:
Sets JPEG output quality from 0 to 100 and returns the Image object for chaining.

### Example

```php
$image = new \Core\Image();
$image->set_jpeg_quality(85);
```

### Notes

- The documentation recommends roughly 80–88 for many web uploads; higher values create larger files.

methods.name: set_png_compression
methods.label: Set PNG Compression
methods.description: Sets PNG compression from 0 to 9 and returns the Image object for chaining.
methods.help:
Sets PNG compression from 0 to 9 and returns the Image object for chaining.

### Example

```php
$image = new \Core\Image();
$image->set_png_compression(7);
```

### Notes

- Higher compression can reduce file size but may use more CPU time.

methods.name: set_webp_quality
methods.label: Set WEBP Quality
methods.description: Sets WEBP output quality from 0 to 100 and returns the Image object for chaining.
methods.help:
Sets WEBP output quality from 0 to 100 and returns the Image object for chaining.

### Example

```php
$image = new \Core\Image();
$image->set_webp_quality(80);
```

### Notes

- The documentation recommends roughly 75–85 for general web thumbnails.

methods.name: allow_upscale
methods.label: Allow Upscale
methods.description: Controls whether resize and contain operations may enlarge images beyond their original dimensions.
methods.help:
Controls whether resize and contain operations may enlarge images beyond their original dimensions.

### Example

```php
$image = new \Core\Image();
$image->allow_upscale(false);
```

### Notes

- Disable upscaling to avoid enlarging small images into blurry output.

methods.name: set_thumbnail_dir
methods.label: Set Thumbnail Directory
methods.description: Stores generated thumbnails in a separate directory instead of beside the original image.
methods.help:
Stores generated thumbnails in a separate directory instead of beside the original image.

### Example

```php
$image = new \Core\Image();
$image->set_thumbnail_dir(ROOTPATH . 'public/uploads/thumbs/');
```

### Notes

- The class creates missing destination directories where possible.

methods.name: use_hashed_names
methods.label: Use Hashed Names
methods.description: Switches generated thumbnail filenames between readable names and hashed names.
methods.help:
Switches generated thumbnail filenames between readable names and hashed names.

### Example

```php
$image = new \Core\Image();
$image->use_hashed_names(true);
```

### Notes

- Readable names are convenient during development. Hashed names are less predictable and can be useful in dedicated thumbnail storage.
